description: Our team has knowledge and experience in programming and web development using technologies such as Python, HTML, and CSS. We use Python for programming, data processing, and logical problem-solving, HTML for structuring web pages, and CSS for designing attractive, responsive, and user-friendly interfaces. By combining these technical skills with creativity, teamwork, and continuous learning, we aim to build innovative digital solutions that address real-world challenges.
summary:
ORBITERA — Earth System Intelligence Platform

ORBITERA is an interactive Earth system investigation platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, addressing “Be An Earth System Trend Detective!”

It helps users investigate environmental changes using Earth observation datasets, identifying trends, anomalies, correlations, and regional differences across variables such as temperature, precipitation, vegetation, soil moisture, and solar radiation.

The platform combines dataset exploration, statistical analysis, interactive visualizations, regional comparisons, and scientific report generation. Its specialized investigation roles—Earth Data Scout, Trend Detective, Anomaly Hunter, Correlation Intelligence, Earth Explainer, and Mission Reporter—organize the research process from data discovery to scientific interpretation.

NASA POWER and other relevant NASA Earth science resources support environmental exploration. AI-assisted explanations make complex findings easier to understand while emphasizing evidence and uncertainty.

Built using React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, Google AI Studio/Gemini, Recharts, and Leaflet, ORBITERA aims to make Earth science more accessible to students, educators, researchers, and environmental enthusiasts.

Its mission is to transform complex Earth data into understandable, evidence-based insights and encourage scientific exploration of our changing planet.
